map.按中国九分法估算成人体表烧伤面积（TBSA），并可按体重估算 24 小时补液量。: Estimate adult total body surface area (TBSA) burned by the Chinese Rule of Nines, and estimate 24-hour fluid resuscitation by body weight.
map.烧伤面积 = 各部位 TBSA 百分比之和；不超过10 轻度、10–30 中度、: Burn area = sum of each region's TBSA percentage; ≤10 mild, 10-30 moderate, 30-50 severe, ≥50 extreme; fluid volume (Parkland formula) = 4 mL × body weight × burn area percentage.
map.📚 深度解析：烧伤面积九分法: 📚 Deep Dive: Burn Area Rule of Nines
map.成人面积估算：按头颈 9%、双上肢 18%、躯干 27%、双下肢 46%、会阴: Adult area estimation: enter the affected proportion of each region by the new Rule of Nines - head/neck 9%, both upper limbs 18%, trunk 27%, both lower limbs 46%, perineum 1% - and sum to TBSA.
map.小面积补充：不足 1 手掌（约 1% TBSA）的散在创面用「手掌法」单独累加，: Small-area supplement: scattered wounds smaller than one palm (~1% TBSA) are added separately by the 'palm method' to avoid rounding errors of the Rule of Nines.
map.儿童校正：对儿童按头大下肢小的年龄修正比例（头颈部=9+(12-年龄)%、双下肢: Pediatric correction: for children, use age-adjusted proportions (head/neck = 9 + (12 - age)%, both lower limbs = 46 - (12 - age)%) because the head is larger and lower limbs smaller, to guide initial fluid estimation.
map.示例：成人右上肢前侧（约占上肢 9% 的一半≈4.5%）+ 前躯干 13.5%，: Example: anterior right upper limb (~half of the 9% upper limb ≈ 4.5%) + anterior trunk 13.5% = ~18% TBSA; the tool gives the area and prompts that moderate burns need timely medical assessment for fluid resuscitation.
map.九分法和手掌法怎么选？: How to choose between the Rule of Nines and the palm method?
map.大面积用九分法整体估算，散在小创面用「1 手掌≈1%」手掌法补充；二者可结合使用: Use the Rule of Nines for large areas and the palm method (1 palm ≈ 1%) for scattered small wounds; the two can be combined for better precision.
